subject: Negative cache kickoff — cheaper dual-encoder training for retrieval
body:
Hi Deshawn,

Kickoff for the negative-cache adoption. Our NeurIPS 2021 open-source release implements a streaming negative cache for dual-encoder training: at each step you sample a negative from a large cache to approximate the cross-entropy loss, instead of paying for in-batch or brute-force negatives. Memory-efficient, simple API (CacheManager + CacheClassificationLoss + a handler).

Why now: retrieval training is the biggest single line in our portfolio's compute spend, and the release's approach should cut effective negative-mining cost substantially at equal quality.

Deliverables: (1) integrate the cache loss into our standard dual-encoder trainer, (2) head-to-head at production scale vs our current negative sampling on the two flagship retrieval benchmarks, (3) adoption guide. Milestones: integration by end of March, mid-scale comparison in May, production-scale run in June, readout by 06-29.

Resourcing from you please — the June run will need a real reservation.

Anders
